openCanvasEvidence.subject: image-editor-session-envelope
openCanvasEvidence.fact: Opening the image editor creates a random sessionId and captures nodeId, media and title, but not graph revision, node-data revision or source-media version.
openCanvasEvidence.translation: Adopt explicit session identity and captured source; add owner/source freshness fields before using the method in LibTV.

openCanvasEvidence.subject: source-load-guard
openCanvasEvidence.fact: The editor tries normalized source candidates with a 20-second per-candidate timeout, limits decoded canvas dimensions/pixels, revokes fallback object URLs and ignores a result after effect cleanup. Cleanup does not abort the active fetch controller; it only suppresses projection.
openCanvasEvidence.translation: Adopt bounded decoding and stale projection suppression; require caller-owned abort for actual cancellation.

openCanvasEvidence.subject: bitmap-local-history
openCanvasEvidence.fact: The bitmap editor captures one full ImageData snapshot after load and after each completed stroke, truncates redo after a new snapshot and keeps at most 40 entries.
openCanvasEvidence.translation: Adopt gesture-level local history and redo invalidation, but reject entry-count-only memory budgeting.

openCanvasEvidence.subject: restore-baseline
openCanvasEvidence.fact: Restore applies snapshot zero and collapses local history to that single baseline, so redo cannot recover the discarded draft.
openCanvasEvidence.translation: Treat Restore as an explicit destructive local command; source evidence is still needed before adopting this exact redo policy for LibTV.

openCanvasEvidence.subject: export-close-order
openCanvasEvidence.fact: Save exports JPEG at quality 0.92, marks the dialog dismissed, closes it, then invokes onSave and reports that upload has started.
openCanvasEvidence.translation: Reuse export timing instrumentation; reject close-before-operation-acceptance unless retry/error ownership remains reachable.

openCanvasEvidence.subject: edited-image-async-handoff
openCanvasEvidence.fact: The caller captures nodeId and current output history, patches the node to running, uploads asynchronously and later appends the result. It does not carry sessionId, source-media version, graph revision or operation identity into completion checks.
openCanvasEvidence.translation: Delegate accepted export to the existing LibTV async-ingress contract with immutable owner/generation/source identities.

openCanvasEvidence.subject: inline-text-drafts
openCanvasEvidence.fact: Title and text body use component-local drafts, commit changed values on blur or Enter/modified Enter, and restore node data on Escape. Effects resynchronize the drafts whenever upstream node data changes, including while editing.
openCanvasEvidence.translation: Adopt local drafts and no-op checks; add an explicit baseline-drift policy instead of silently replacing an active draft.

openCanvasEvidence.subject: rich-note-draft
openCanvasEvidence.fact: Rich notes edit directly in a contentEditable DOM, sanitize on blur or modified Enter, and restore original HTML on Escape. There is no custom note-history stack or captured revision.
openCanvasEvidence.translation: Keep sanitization at commit, but do not infer that DOM ownership alone is a sufficient session model.

openCanvasEvidence.subject: graph-mutation-guard
openCanvasEvidence.fact: updateNodeData normalizes data, rejects equal patches and blocks mutation during a graph revision conflict. Editor handlers generally ignore the returned mutation result and still exit editing or continue async work.
openCanvasEvidence.translation: Adopt equality/conflict guards and require commit acceptance to control editor close/failure state.

openCanvasEvidence.subject: persistence-is-not-editor-history
openCanvasEvidence.fact: Open Canvas tracks graph dirty/save/revision/conflict state and can three-way merge saves, but the fixed shared code has no graph undo/redo stack; the only custom undo/redo is inside the bitmap editor.
openCanvasEvidence.translation: Use this as strong evidence that editor-local history, graph history and durable save are separate authorities.

cloneEvidence.subject: text-node-draft
cloneEvidence.fact: TextNode owns a nullable local draft, commits changed content on blur and cancels on Escape; its component specification still incorrectly says changes do not reach canvasStore.
cloneEvidence.risk: Escape-triggered unmount and blur ordering is not explicitly guarded, and documentation is stale.

cloneEvidence.subject: image-generation-panel
cloneEvidence.fact: Prompt, references, AutoLink and submitted feedback are component-local. Generate only flips submitted; the visible Undo button has no handler; unmount loses the draft.
cloneEvidence.risk: The surface looks commit-capable but has no graph or async handoff.

cloneEvidence.subject: image-annotate-mode
cloneEvidence.fact: Annotate has owner-aware top-level UI state and local tool/color/width controls, but no annotation records or history. Undo/redo are disabled while an enabled-looking Save button has no handler.
cloneEvidence.risk: Save is a high-salience inert command.

cloneEvidence.subject: image-element-edit-mode
cloneEvidence.fact: Element Edit is explicitly an empty authoring shell: tools are local, Undo and Generate are disabled, and close/selection/owner invalidation changes no graph history.
cloneEvidence.risk: This is honest placeholder behavior, but it does not prove full source editor semantics.

cloneEvidence.subject: picture-edit-history
cloneEvidence.fact: Picture Edit keeps at most 30 mark snapshots, coalesces pointer movement into a completed interaction, deep-clones marks on submit and later creates one graph transaction after a local timer.
cloneEvidence.risk: Description and replacement edits call replaceMarks rather than commitMarks, so local undo does not represent every meaningful draft edit.

cloneEvidence.subject: subtitle-region-history
cloneEvidence.fact: Region subtitle erase keeps at most 30 snapshots, coalesces draw/move/resize gestures, deep-clones regions on confirm and immediately creates a graph transaction; Escape/close discards local regions.
cloneEvidence.risk: There is no submitting/idempotency guard at the panel boundary.

cloneEvidence.subject: video-continuation-range
cloneEvidence.fact: Continuation owns a local range and pointer drag session; cancel discards it and confirm produces one graph transaction. It has no local undo/redo stack.
cloneEvidence.risk: The pattern is sound for a small scalar draft but has no explicit owner revision.

cloneEvidence.subject: segment-reshoot-local-task
cloneEvidence.fact: Segment Reshoot keeps selected segments, intent and submission feedback locally; submit only flips a local flag and the component exposes no cancel callback.
cloneEvidence.risk: It is a non-dismissable local simulation rather than a commit-capable editor session.

cloneEvidence.subject: timed-processing-panels
cloneEvidence.fact: Smart Matting, Picture Edit and Depth Motion use component timers as submitting simulations, disable primary controls and create graph placeholders after the delay.
cloneEvidence.risk: Timers are not durable operation identities and do not model retry/failure/freshness.

cloneEvidence.subject: camera-dialogs
cloneEvidence.fact: Both dialogs have local config and apply/cancel-shaped UI, but no repository caller was found. Because the components remain mounted when isOpen is false, canceled draft values would persist into the next reopen.
cloneEvidence.risk: Dead prototype components should not be treated as current product contracts.

cloneEvidence.subject: inert-history-chrome
cloneEvidence.fact: Video Processing shows enabled-looking Undo/Redo buttons with no handlers, and Image Edit shows an enabled-looking Undo button with no handler.
cloneEvidence.risk: Visual parity currently overstates behavioral parity.

cloneEvidence.subject: graph-history-gateway
cloneEvidence.fact: canvasStore updateNodeData always pushes one graph snapshot when the node exists and has no equality guard; graph undo/redo clear selection.
cloneEvidence.risk: Live controls and duplicate patches can inflate graph history, while undo can indirectly unmount an active editor.

cloneEvidence.subject: active-image-command-ownership
cloneEvidence.fact: Owner reconciliation closes image editors after node/canvas invalidation, and active image modes capture Escape/Delete/Tab/Space/undo/redo so commands do not fall through to graph actions.
cloneEvidence.risk: Command ownership is stronger than draft semantics: close always discards because no dirty/commit model exists.

cloneEvidence.subject: director-motion-path-comparison
cloneEvidence.fact: Director uses a typed motionPathDraft, appends/updates anchors, validates on finish and clears on cancel. It is a separate-store comparison and does not establish ordinary LibTV graph-history semantics.
cloneEvidence.risk: Reusing its store shape across routes would violate the route/store boundary.

evidenceBoundary: Static code presence does not prove exercised browser behavior or LibTV source parity.
Open Canvas behavior is a method and counterexample source, not a source-site oracle.
No source-site editing, upload, save, provider execution or paid action was performed in this audit.
Line anchors identify the fixed baseline and may drift after the submodule or clone advances.
